name: agromaslahat
description: Agromaslahat — O'zbekiston fermerlari uchun agrar maslahat platformasi

scripts.dev: concurrently -n db,api,web -c green,blue,magenta "npm run db:local -w server" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:no-db: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
